test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To know what’s what

options.text: To know the facts of a situation
To be in a difficult situation

solution:
The correct answer is **'To know the facts of a situation'.**
